resources.string: Ready to play. Press Play for a 4..3..2..1 click count-in followed by the rhythm.
Choose 4/4, 3/4, 2/2, 5/4, or 7/4 time from the top-left selector, adjust BPM from 40 to 200 with the slider, and toggle Loop for continuous practice.
Press Play to hear a 4..3..2..1 metronome count-in followed by the rhythm played on a clear 440 Hz reference tone with synchronized beat-cursor tracking.

Tap Edit to enter Edit Mode. Tap any note or rest on the score, then assign Whole, Half, Quarter, Eighth, or Sixteenth notes and rests. Add/remove bars (1–4 measures) or tap Randomize to generate fresh sight-reading rhythms.
